newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Pakhoed issue raises 200 mln guilders.
newsitem.headline: Pakhoed issue raises 200 mln guilders.

text.p: Dutch tank storage and shipping group Pakhoed NV said on Friday it had issued 16 million non-voting cumulative preference shares at 12.50 guilders each, raising 200 million guilders.
The subscription closed on Friday at noon.
The newly issued shares will have limited exchangeability and will not be listed, the company said.
They will be privately placed on December 4 with a number of Dutch institutional investors.
Pakhoed announced on Monday it planned to issue 16 million preference shares.
